statistics.unit: paired independent process block; median log ratio
statistics.time: cold whole process block including all rebuild repeats
statistics.rss: separate same-repetition fresh process absolute peak

admission.benefit: at least one predeclared successful same-output group: CI entirely below 1 for cold block or absolute RSS
admission.policy: all groups retained; any >20% median regression blocks a global default replacement

protocol.cost_scope: import/manifest/input/solver/mandatory validators/topology/joint queries/two batches/snapshot/recovery/requery/streamed P,L generator audit/JSON output/exit; no profiler

route_policy.r0: pinned Phase3 source; reference scalar geometry; legacy family/schema1
route_policy.reference: candidate source; reference solver/scalar; adjacent family/schema2
route_policy.integrated: explicit native certified solver, or Factorized Feasible; reusable geometry workspace for supported action; adjacent family/schema2
route_policy.native_explicit: candidate NativeFeasibleSolver, workspace geometry; width>64 is a declared Unavailable probe
route_policy.factorized_batch: candidate Factorized plus transient native geometry workspace
route_policy.hc_workspace: candidate HC plus reusable native geometry workspace
route_policy.legacy_family: candidate reference scalar pipeline, only family.py loaded from R0
